raw_posts.name: TheySaid 4.0
raw_posts.tagline: See how users will react, right where you build.
raw_posts.description: Put what you’re building in front of real customers or synthetic users trained on them when you need an answer in minutes without leaving Claude, Cursor, or Jira. Nothing ships on a guess.

raw_posts.name: Overmind
raw_posts.description: Overmind is the model training platform for AI teams. Turn your production traces into specialised models you own, trained, benchmarked, and served.

raw_posts.name: Spacesheep
raw_posts.tagline: Documents of the future, made by AI, read by your team
raw_posts.description: Spacesheep (YC F26) turns any agent's work into a space: an interactive doc, live dashboard, mockup or app. Share it with specific people, your team or publicly, and collaborate on it together.

raw_posts.name: Orbit
raw_posts.tagline: Stop doomscrolling. Earn every app unlock.
raw_posts.description: Doomscrolling is free. Orbit makes it cost something. Pick a schedule and your apps lock themselves. Want back in early? Earn it: hold the orb, do squats, ask a friend, pay a little more each time, or win a shift at The Gate. Most times, you’ll stay out.

raw_posts.name: SavorApp_AI
raw_posts.tagline: Capture what matters and move your intentions forward
raw_posts.description: Savor is an Intention Layer™ for thoughts that never reach your to-do list. Speak, type, or snap a photo to create a clear card in Now, Soon, or Later. Reminders bring it back when it matters. Take Action (Beta) helps you explore options, build a plan or list, and draft words you can use. Review and adjust as you go. Hand off a card or a single step, with a private chat for context. You decide what happens next. Free on iOS and Android.

raw_posts.name: Notra
raw_posts.tagline: Notra is a GEO tool that helps you rank in AI Search.
raw_posts.description: Notra is a GEO tool that asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini the questions your buyers ask. It shows whether you appear, who appears instead and how to fix it.

raw_posts.name: Nuvio 5.0
raw_posts.tagline: Hand your financial admin to your AI agent
raw_posts.description: Automate invoicing, expenses and reconciliation. Ask Nuvio’s assistant to do the work, or connect ChatGPT, Claude or your own AI agent. We’re also adding bookkeeping and tax services with accountants who already know Nuvio.

raw_posts.name: PulseDev
raw_posts.tagline: Click any UI bug on localhost and your AI agent fixes it
raw_posts.description: Stop describing UI bugs to your AI. Click any element on your localhost site, say what's wrong, and Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenCode edits the right file. Watch it work live, then approve the diff on the page. Nothing is written until you do.

raw_posts.name: iPad mini 8
raw_posts.tagline: OLED, A20 Pro and IP67 in Apple's smallest iPad
raw_posts.description: The all new iPad mini. Featuring the 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR display with OLED, A20 Pro chip, Apple Intelligence and Siri AI. Supports Apple Pencil.

raw_posts.name: Arcade Controller Pro
raw_posts.tagline: A fight controller with no stick and its own screen
raw_posts.description: A customizable all-button arcade controller with a compact layout, built-in display, hot-swappable switches, RGB lighting, and a magnetic wrist rest.
